notes.title: New Mana System & Balancing
notes.content:
Over the course of the last month we've analysed the meta, and figured out the limitless mana system was essentially to blame for a large part of the unbalance for caster classes.

So today we're taking steps to bring that back into balance! Mana now has a maximum cap that increases per level, casters recover it slowly each turn, and mana cards are boosted.

We've also taken steps to rebalance enemies including the Lich and have fixed a tonne of bugs!

Feel free to jump into discord or let us know in the forum what you think of the changes!

notes.title: Monk Class Update!
notes.content:
Deck builders have been chomping at the bit for this for some time!

The Monk class is the 10th included class in the game and brings a whole new way to play including the secret 3rd, 5th and 8th Gates which are unlocked as you progress!

Now go smash the Lich one more time!

notes.title: PC Release is live!
notes.content:
Thanks to the tireless efforts of our Discord and QQ deckbuilder communities, I am very happy to make the PC release available on Steam!

As is usual, please do leave feedback in the forum, join Discord or QQ for more discussion, live updates and sharing your builds! 

Things to look for coming up are the Monk class which is finishing beta shortly this week!

Happy deck building, go slay that Lich one more time!
